SELECT p.id, p.supplier_id, p.brand, p.part_no, p.package_type, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS stock_quantity, ROUND(SUM(i.unit_cost * i.quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(i.quantity), 0), 4) AS estimated_cost, MIN(i.unit_cost) AS min_cost, MAX(i.unit_cost) AS max_cost FROM product p LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = p.id AND i.quantity > 0
(LOCATE(#{keyword}, p.brand) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, p.part_no) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, p.package_type) > 0 OR CAST(p.id AS CHAR) = #{keyword})
GROUP BY p.id, p.supplier_id, p.brand, p.part_no, p.package_type ORDER BY p.id

SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.batch_no, i.date_code, i.lot_code, i.quantity, i.unit_cost, o.inbound_time AS inbound_time FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN inbound_order_item oi ON oi.id = i.inbound_order_item_id LEFT JOIN inbound_order o ON o.id = oi.inbound_order_id WHERE i.product_id = #{productId} AND i.quantity > 0 ORDER BY o.inbound_time, i.batch_no, i.id
